question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Capture
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Liberate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Capture"** in English means to take into one's possession or control by force or stratagem; to seize (पकड़ना).

 
 
• **Example:** The king sent his army to capture the enemy fortress.
 
 
 
• The word "**Liberate**" is an antonym of "Capture", meaning to set free, especially from imprisonment or oppression (मुक्त करना).
 
 
• **Example: **The soldiers were sent to liberate the hostages captured by the insurgents.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is - **'Liberate'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Abolish' **(Option 1) means to officially end a law, system etc., especially one that has existed for a long time (समाप्त करना).
 
• **'Establish'** (Option 2) means to set up or found, especially relating to an organization or a system (स्थापित करना).
 
• **'Seize' **(Option 4) often used interchangeably with 'capture', means to take hold of hastily, forcibly, or with authority (जब्त करना).
